notes.title: 🎮 New VR GAME! 🌟 "Hentai Hunter" Now Available!
notes.notes:
🎮 New VR GAME! 🌟 "Hentai Hunter" Now Available!

Attention, fellow adventurers! The thrilling game "Hentai Hunter" for virtual reality has just hit the shelves! Get ready for an immersive hunting experience in the virtual world. 

Join the action now and step into the shoes of a true hentai hunter in VR!

notes.title: TOMORROW November 30th! Game Release Announcement!
notes.notes:
Dear Gamers,

We are thrilled to announce that our latest game will be officially released tomorrow, Thursday, November 30th, at 17:00 UTC on the Steam platform!

Get ready for an incredible adventure; the excitement is about to peak! We can't wait for you to experience this amazing journey in our new gaming world.

Be prepared, don your helmets, and get ready to step into the shoes of a hero tomorrow at 17:00 UTC on Steam!

Thank you for your support and patience. The unforgettable adventure is about to begin very soon!

With warm regards,
Hentai Hunter Team
